name: Aobazuku Mion
source:
Hobbies: Spending time with [url=/c83261]Touko[/url]-sama, making pickled food
Liked food: Vegetables
Disliked food: Seafood

After being saved from bullies by Touko a few years ago, Mion latched onto her and became devoted, acting as her attendant. She loves cute things. Mion is a bit of a ditz and as a result, her tempo during conversations is different from the others. Due to the bullying, she has a hard time talking with people around the same age as her.
Not good at cooking, but she likes making pickled foods.
